name: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 (V3)
description: ESP32-S3 + SX1262 LoRa board with 0.96-inch OLED, LiPo charger and USB-C for about $18; the go-to cheap Meshtastic/LoRaWAN node with Wi-Fi and BLE.
notes: ESP32-S3FN8 (8 MB in-package flash), SX1262 LoRa (buy the 433, 470-510, 863-870 or 902-928 MHz version for your region), 0.96-inch 128x64 OLED, CP2102 USB-UART plus native USB.
LoRa antenna goes on the U.FL/IPEX connector: always attach it before transmitting. SH1.25-2 LiPo connector with on-board charging; Vext pin switches a 3.3 V rail for sensors.
28 GPIOs on the 2x18 headers, several of which drive on-board parts (OLED on 17/18/21, LED 35, Vext 36, USB 19/20, PRG button 0). V3.1/V3.2 revisions differ slightly (LoRa power, ADC control).
Price range $17.90-19.90 at Heltec depending on band and accessories.
